- t: መካሕ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ይብል ፡ ዘመዐዛሁ ፡ ሠናይ ፡ ወአዶናይ ፡ ብሂል ፡ ቃለ ፡ አብ ፡ ዘእምቅድመ ፡ ዓለም ፡ ወልደ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ይለብስ ፡ ዘበሶር ፡ ግሩም ፡ ሶበ ፡ ይብል ፡ ሥጋሁ ፡ ለአዳም ፡ ገሃደ ፡ ያርኢ ።
- i: 'Mekah,' when he says it, means 'one whose fragrance is good'; and 'Adonai' means the Word of the Father who is from before the world, the Son of God. And when he says 'he puts on that of Bosor, awesome', he plainly shows his body, which is Adam's.

Words in this part: 422.
